decision: All nine app-local wrappers have no callers or reflective dispatch. This private Angular application is not a published client library. Remove only these wrappers; do not redirect legacy requests to Hub response shapes.
compatibility: Hub replacements are already used by domain services. Legacy payload/error schemas differ; no parity is claimed and no mounted endpoint is changed. Candidate, Recruiter, Stats, account-deletion compatibility and all Admin/Tenant controllers retained.
